answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to lock capital to validate transactions. In this mesa of decentralized computation, an attacker faces a financial nadir if they attempt to flood the network with fake identities, as the cost of acquiring sufficient stake for meaningful influence exceeds the potential gain. The arduous voyage of accumulating capital ensures that identity creation remains prohibitively expensive, effectively securing the economy against malicious scaling.
